records.rule: Check both bytes and inodes. `df -h` alone is insufficient for archives containing many small files.
Compressed size is not extraction size. Read the ZIP central directory and total uncompressed member sizes before extraction.
A valid ZIP can have a dangerous expansion ratio. Preflight ratio and archive paths before extracting.
An attached or library file may not be mounted in the execution workspace. Use the host materialisation route when needed; never infer a sandbox path from the title.
If the requested materialisation/extraction cannot fit with reserve, stop before partial work and prepare handover with exact artifact identity and continuation state.

Context is recoverable only if durable state exists outside transient conversational recollection: setup/provenance, active spheres, qualification/change record, exact artifact digests and next action.
